title: best practice
description: A kind's best practice. Its goal holds the goal's sentence and the critical success factors, the few things that must go right for the deliverable's users to reach that goal. Each factor holds its necessary conditions, each a state of the deliverable that the factor needs, written as a question such a deliverable answers yes to, and each condition holds its practice: its why, which says what the condition gives the users and the method the items come from, and its items, each marked `decide` or `make` by when the maker takes it. It names the template beside it, which holds the form a good deliverable of the kind takes, and whose sections each condition's about names. It names in inputs each kind such a deliverable rests on, by the name of its best practice's folder, with the sections it takes. An evaluator gets its goal, its factors, and its conditions, without their practices.

inputs.description: Each kind of deliverable that this kind rests on, read or run, with the sections of that kind's template that it takes, which its first practice reads. A kind it only runs, such as the code that an E2E test runs, takes no section.

kind.description: The folder name of the input's best practice.

takes.description: Each section of the input kind's template that this kind takes, by its heading.

condition.description: A necessary condition, with its practice.

why.description: What the condition gives the users, and the method the items come from, with its source.

items.description: Each decision with its question and criterion, each step, and the check from the users' side, in the order the maker takes them. An item's ID is its condition's ID and its place, such as N6.2, which a role names in its result once it has taken the item.

at.description: When the maker takes the item: `decide` while it settles the work's decisions, `make` while it makes the deliverable.
